# `~`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the result of bitwise NOT of `expr`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
~ expr
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `bitwise_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- ~, example 1
> SELECT ~ 0;
-1
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
